source: Trane Technologies press release: Trane Technologies Expands System Architecture with Two New (09-28-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Trane Technologies added two new 250-megawatt high-density AI factory reference designs based on the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory platform, both zero water consumption cooling architectures using technology from its recently acquired LiquidStack and Stellar Energy. Reference Design #506 (air-cooled) couples direct-to-chip liquid cooling with Trane Ascend ACR air-cooled chillers with integrated free cooling: up to a 25% cooling efficiency improvement, up to 22 MW of power reallocated to compute, and annualized partial PUE improved from 1.201 to 1.083. Reference Design #507 is Trane's first featuring Stellar Energy factory-built modular cooling plants (CenTraVac water-cooled chillers with dry fluid coolers): Water Usage Effectiveness of zero, up to a 16% chiller power improvement, 8 MW reallocated to AI workloads. The LiquidStack GigaModular CDU integrated across both designs has qualified as an NVIDIA DSX Ready CDU; it delivers capacity up to 14 MW at a 4 degree C approach and up to 20% lower capital expenditure than conventional row-based CDU installations (company claim). CTO Mauro J. Atalla: the designs help data center developers 'overcome skilled labor shortages, compress deployment timelines and reclaim critical power for AI factories'.
